messages:
Evan: Quick alert - lapel on guest presenter is cutting intermittently, sounds like a loose cable. AV recommends hot-swap to handheld. Can stage team prep?
Rae: Copy. Handheld mic ready at Stage Left. I'll hand off in 20s.
Tomas: Heads up streaming team: swapping mics will introduce a short audio dip. Recommend enabling a 0.5s blackout overlay or lower caption ingestion briefly.
Kira: I'll pause captions for the swap to avoid duplicated lines. Will resume immediately after.
Evan: Hosts, please hold applause cue until we confirm levels after the swap.
Rae: Handheld live on Stage Left, prepping to handover.
Tomas: On OBS: Im routing handheld to mix bus B and keeping iso recorder on A to preserve continuity. Command: 
```
AudioInput.Map handheld -> MixBusB
Recorder.LockTrack A
```
Tomas: Swap complete. Levels -6dB avg, no clipping. Confirm on livestream? :white_check_mark:
stream-bot: [automated] Live health: audio_peak=-5.9dB, viewers=830, latency=1.8s
Kira: Captions resumed, low-latency enabled. There might be a ~1s catch-up.
Olivia (CEO): Thanks. Small ask: since this pushed us a minute, can we move the roadmap Qs to the end of segment instead of now? I want the demo to finish uninterrupted.
Evan: Agreed. We'll queue roadmap Qs for post-demo. Hosts notified.
Rae: Also uploaded a short clip of the swap for editors: /recordings/edits/swap_clip.mp4
Kira: If post caption sync needed, use iso audio from /recordings/iso/stage_left.wav to re-time.
Evan: I'll drop a quick ops note in #all-hands after with timestamps and who took the mic. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
